checkpoints.quote: BANK-425 is a duplicate of BANK-440. Both tickets report the same issue: the web dashboard/home screen balance does not update immediately after a transfer due to caching.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly identifies BANK-425 as a duplicate of BANK-440, both concerning the web dashboard/home screen balance staying stale after a transfer.

checkpoints.quote: BANK-425: Action: Close as a duplicate of BANK-440. Why: Exact same symptoms (stale balance after transfer, refresh ineffective), root cause (BalanceCache not invalidated), and fix (clear cache on transfer success) described in its comment. Owner: Unassigned → Link to BANK-440.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis recommends closing one and keeping the other, links them, and preserves the root-cause analysis; the key accepts either direction as long as tickets are linked and analysis is preserved.

checkpoints.quote: MOB-88: Action: Complete the fix by switching notification event to TransferCompleted (not TransferRequested). Why: Separate issue (push notification shows pre-transfer balance), not a duplicate of BANK-440. Owner: Ravi Kumar (current assignee). Status: Already in progress (updated 2026-09-11).
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly states MOB-88 is not a duplicate, identifies it as a push-notification issue with a different cause (TransferRequested event), and notes it is in progress with Ravi Kumar.

checkpoints.quote: The root cause (local storage cache for 15 minutes not invalidated) and fix (clear cache on transfer success) are identical.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis correctly identifies the 15-minute BalanceCache in local storage as the cause and clearing it on transfer success as the fix.
